title: Scaled Relative Graphs and Dynamic Integral Quadratic Constraints: Connections and Computations for Nonlinear Systems
summary: Scaled relative graphs (SRGs) enable graphical analysis and design of nonlinear systems. In this paper, we present a systematic approach for computing both soft and hard SRGs of nonlinear systems using dynamic integral quadratic constraints (IQCs). These constraints are exploited via application of the S-procedure to compute tractable SRG overbounds. In particular, we show that the multipliers associated with the IQCs define regions in the complex plane.
